messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":7,"verses":[{"chapter":7,"verse":1,"text":"At this time the kings heard what had happened to me and they rose and came to me. each from his land to visit me and to comfort me."},{"chapter":7,"verse":2,"text":"And when they came near me, they cried with a loud voice and each tore his clothes."},{"chapter":7,"verse":3,"text":"And after they had prostrated themselves, touching the earth with their heads, they sat down next to me for seven days and seven nights, and none spoke a word."},{"chapter":7,"verse":4,"text":"They were four in numbers: Eliplaz, the king of Teman, and Balad, and Sophar, and Elilhu."},{"chapter":7,"verse":5,"text":"And when they had taken their seat, they conversed about what had happened to me."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 1,2,3,4,5 in this chapter.
